purpose: Teach: 符号/執拗/再三/先々/最長/怠慢/随所/つくろ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内通信に符号化を導入しろ
lines.en: Implement encryption protocols for all internal communications.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. Clipped articulation on each phrase. No warmth—authority settling in. Expects compliance. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。執拗なクレーマー対応もマニュアル化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll also standardize the procedures for handling persistent complaints.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Rapid note-taking pace. Quick nod in the voice. Proving he's tracking every detail. Eager to deliver.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、再三の警告にも従わない取引先を整理しろ
lines.en: Audit and terminate relationships with clients who ignore our warnings.
lines.style: Steel underneath the quiet. Each word lands with weight. Pause before the instruction—this is serious. Not angry, but final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先々の業績見通しを共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare a forward-looking performance analysis to share with the team.
lines.style: Steady, measured response. Slight lift on 'analysis'—showing he's already thinking three steps ahead. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 最長の契約期間も検討しろ
lines.en: Review and extend the maximum contract terms where appropriate.
lines.style: Lower register, almost musing aloud. Not quite a question but inviting consideration. Strategic, not rushed. Eyes narrowing slightly with thought.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の怠慢を見逃しません
lines.en: Understood. We won't overlook any lapses in employee performance.
lines.style: Quick, clipped confirmation. Snap of commitment on the final clause. Showing he understands the stakes. No hedging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品設計の随所に工夫を加えろ
lines.en: Introduce refinements throughout the product line design.
lines.style: Expansive, almost visionary. Slow, deliberate pacing. Hands moving slightly in the voice—painting a bigger picture. Expectation of excellence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い慣習をつくろう新ルールを作ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll sunset the outdated practices and establish clear new protocols across the board.
lines.style: Firm closure. Slight acceleration toward the end—wrapping things up with momentum. Finality but not coldness. Ready to execute.
